question: Should durable parent/root/trace lineage be owned by the persisted session contract, TaskFlow, or a deliberately defined bridge between them?
rationale: The implementation necessarily creates a cross-surface correlation contract; code review cannot safely choose its long-term owner or trace-identifier semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define session-owned lineage
options.body: Make the persisted session model the canonical parent/root/trace source and have TaskFlow consume that contract.

options.title: Define TaskFlow-owned lineage
options.body: Keep durable task correlation in TaskFlow and expose only a documented bridge into session projections.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Leave current parent/depth metadata in place until a broader orchestration identity design is approved.

recommendation.title: Define session-owned lineage
recommendation.body: Make the persisted session model the canonical parent/root/trace source and have TaskFlow consume that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and prior review place this person closest to the session/gateway boundary and the unresolved ownership decision.
